anchors.description: Chord across the printed certificate inside the middle framed document on the rear wall, taken between the midpoints of its left and right inner edges = paper short-side width (US Letter 8.5 in / A4 210 mm)
anchors.visible_evidence: Portrait white sheet with typed text and a signature fills the thin black frame; both endpoints lie on the sheet a few pixels inside its left/right inner edges at mid-height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Sheet is US Letter (0.2159 m) or A4 (0.210 m); a white mat border or a diploma-size sheet would shift the true paper edges; endpoint placement error about +/-3 px.

anchors.description: Chord across the same certificate between the midpoints of its top and bottom inner edges = paper long-side height (US Letter 11 in / A4 297 mm)
anchors.visible_evidence: Same white printed sheet; the endpoints sit on the sheet just below the top inner edge and just above the bottom inner edge, at mid-width.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: US Letter/A4 ambiguity plus possible small mat margin; frame inner edges are thin and low contrast, endpoint error about +/-3-4 px.

anchors.description: Length of the linear twin-lamp fluorescent luminaire on the ceiling of the adjoining corridor, from left end cap to right end
anchors.visible_evidence: A long, continuous bright bar with two parallel luminous tube lines and dark end caps runs left-right on the far corridor ceiling; both endpoints are placed at the housing ends.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Assumed a nominal 48-inch (4-ft) luminaire/tube length, dominant in US offices; a 40-inch or 8-ft variant would change the scale, and the left end sits close to the doorway head with a few pixels of endpoint ambiguity.
